messages.死ぬこと自体が本領の人格。「好餌妖精」で攻撃を集めて倒れ、死亡時のパッシブで最後: An Identity whose main payoff comes from dying. Fairy Lure draws attacks until he falls, then his on-death passive inflicts substantial Rupture on his last attacker and supplies 8 E.G.O resources.
messages.バトルパッシブ「外見もまた在りしL社のE.G.Oに比し幻想体により近き形にて抽出: **Combat passive — This is reflected in their appearance, more closely resembling the source Abnormality than E.G.O of the former L Corp. do (3 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On death, inflicts 4/5 Rupture and 2/3 Rupture Count on his last attacker, and gains 2 resources of each of the 4 least-owned Sin affinities. Having Fairy Lure doubles the Rupture Potency inflicted. If there was no attacker, targets the enemy with the lowest Rupture Count instead. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.好餌妖精(最大5): S3と守備で好餌妖精2/3を得る(1ターンにつき1回)。タ: **Fairy Lure (maximum 5)**: S3 and defense grant 2/3 Fairy Lure, once per turn. At Turn Start, his leftmost dashboard slot gains 10 Aggro, and he takes +50% damage. When hit, inflicts 1 Rupture on the attacker, up to 3 times per enemy skill, plus 1 more below 50% HP. This hit-triggered Rupture stops applying at 15 or more Rupture Potency on the attacker. Loses 1 Fairy Lure at Turn End.
messages.マッチ敗北で強化: S1・S2は自分を狙うスキルの数に応じてマッチ敗北時の最終威: **Benefits from Clash Losses**: S1 and S2 gain Final Power after losing a Clash based on the number of skills targeting him. Losing also increases the Rupture they inflict by 1/2: Potency for S1, Count for S2. All their Coins are inherently Unbreakable. If the target has at least 15 Rupture Potency and 3 Count, S1 stops inflicting Potency and S2 stops inflicting Count.
messages.挑発: S1・S2・S3・守備は使用時に次のターンの挑発値を得る(S3・守備は6: **Aggro**: On use, S1, S2, S3, and defense grant Aggro next turn. S3 and defense grant 6/8.
messages.サポートパッシブ「E.G.Oの崩壊するとき、肥料のごとく分解さる。」(暴食×5・: **Support passive — E.G.O disintegration is not unlike decomposition of compost (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the 1 ally with the lowest current HP dies, gains 2 resources of each of the 2 least-owned Sin affinities.
messages.まず暴食×3を保有してバトルパッシブを有効にし、S3か守備で好餌妖精を得て挑発値: First Own 3 Gluttony to activate his combat passive. Gain Fairy Lure with S3 or defense, then draw attacks with Aggro. Each hit adds Rupture to the attacker. When he dies with Fairy Lure, his passive delivers doubled Rupture Potency and additional Count to his last attacker while generating 8 E.G.O resources. S1 and S2 can inflict Rupture even after a Clash Loss, so winning is not essential to their role. Because the plan involves him dying and being replaced, he suits Chain Battles that bring in another Identity afterward. He is less suitable for battles without replacements. One approach is deliberately leaving him at a low level so that he falls sooner.
